confidence_notes: The inspection verified the ASP.NET WebForms search controls, first-page row structure, counter, detail URL pattern, and one detail page, but did not execute pagination.
The script uses Playwright because the target requires ASP.NET postbacks and browser interaction; no network API was observed.
Product IDs are consistently derived from the RNET registration number in the detail URL or heading; no SKU, MPN, or canonical slug was observed.
The target has no product prices, so no price field or price extraction is invented.
Detail label/value layouts beyond the sampled fields were not fully inspected; address, contacts, brand, operator, and tax-number extraction therefore includes low-confidence/missing-field flags.
The inspection did not test reviewer accordions or PII masking. The script skips accordion interaction and applies masking only to extracted fields whose key or value indicates review content.

Input files with recognized keyword/listing_url/detail_url headers are processed normally. If no recognized header is present, the first Excel column is treated as keyword data, including the first row.
The diagnostic zero-record flow performs a fresh target-page navigation and screenshot after the crawl, which may itself encounter anti-bot protection.
